# Queue configuration

| Setting | Default | Valid range | Behavior |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `visibilitySeconds` | 45 | 5–600 | Time before an unacknowledged job is visible again |
| `maxAttempts` | 3 | 1–8 | Includes the first delivery attempt |
| `backoffMs` | 400 | 100–5000 | Base delay between retry attempts |
| `deadLetterAfter` | 8 | 1–20 | Failed jobs moved to the dead-letter queue |

`maxAttempts` counts the initial delivery. A value of `1` disables retries.

Authentication errors (`401` and `403`) are never retried, even when `maxAttempts` is greater than one.

```yaml
queue:
  maxAttempts: 4
  backoffMs: 800
```

Configuration changes take effect after the worker restarts.

- `visibilitySeconds` is measured in seconds
- `backoffMs` is measured in milliseconds

import re, collections
def vals(path):
    s=open(path,encoding="utf-8").read()
    spans=re.findall(r"`([^`\n]+)`", s)                       # inline code values
    nums=re.findall(r"\b\d[\d.,]*(?:–\d[\d.,]*)?\b", s)        # numbers & ranges
    units=re.findall(r"\b(?:seconds|milliseconds|ms)\b", s)    # units
    idents=re.findall(r"\b(?:visibilitySeconds|maxAttempts|backoffMs|deadLetterAfter|queue|yaml)\b", s)
    fences=re.findall(r"^```(\w*)$", s, re.M)
    blocks=re.findall(r"```[a-z]*\n(.*?)```", s, re.S)
    return dict(spans=spans,nums=nums,units=units,idents=idents,fences=fences,blocks=blocks)
A,B=vals("input.md"),vals("output.md")
for k in A:
    same = collections.Counter(map(str,A[k]))==collections.Counter(map(str,B[k]))
    print(f"{k:7} identical: {same}")
    if not same:
        print("   input :",A[k]); print("   output:",B[k])
print("code block bodies byte-identical:", [x==y for x,y in zip(A['blocks'],B['blocks'])])
